chapters.theme_en: food security and agriculture under climate change
chapters.theme_id: ketahanan pangan dan pertanian di tengah perubahan iklim

en.lead: For food security and agriculture, the near term appears in yields and prices: by 2040 wheat yields fall 8–15% and maize 10–18% in South Asia and the Sahel, rice drops 5–10% from night heat, and tropical fish catch falls 10–20%, pushing 40–60 million more people into hunger.
en.mid: By 2050, simultaneous breadbasket failures become plausible and food prices swing 20–35% in bad years; by 2100 a high-emissions path cuts staple output 20–30% without adaptation, while irrigation demand rises 30–40% (Zhao et al., 2017; FAO, 2023).
en.adapt: Heat-tolerant seeds, sowing 2–3 weeks earlier, drip and mulch saving 30% of water, fish ponds and village grain banks smooth the lean months.
en.watch: Watch local yields per hectare, the date of the first reliable rain, and staple prices in the nearest market; crop response to heat is high-confidence, but farm-level losses depend on soil, seed choice and irrigation.

id.lead: Bagi ketahanan pangan dan pertanian, jangka dekat tampak pada hasil panen dan harga: pada 2040 hasil gandum turun 8–15% dan jagung 10–18% di Asia Selatan dan Sahel, padi turun 5–10% akibat panas malam, dan tangkapan ikan tropis turun 10–20%, mendorong 40–60 juta orang tambahan ke kelaparan.
id.mid: Pada 2050, gagal panen serentak di beberapa lumbung pangan menjadi mungkin dan harga pangan berayun 20–35% di tahun buruk; pada 2100 jalur emisi tinggi memangkas produksi pangan pokok 20–30% tanpa adaptasi, sementara kebutuhan irigasi naik 30–40% (Zhao dkk., 2017; FAO, 2023).
id.adapt: Benih tahan panas, tanam 2–3 minggu lebih awal, tetes dan mulsa yang menghemat 30% air, kolam ikan serta lumbung desa meredakan bulan paceklik.
id.watch: Pantau hasil per hektar setempat, tanggal hujan andal pertama, dan harga pangan pokok di pasar terdekat; respons tanaman terhadap panas berkeyakinan tinggi, tetapi kerugian tingkat usahatani bergantung pada tanah, pilihan benih dan irigasi.

en.lead: For ecosystems and biodiversity, the near term is measured in bleaching and range shifts: by 2040 coral reefs face annual bleaching across 90% of tropical reefs, 15–25% of bird ranges move upslope, and mangroves lose 10–20% where seas rise fastest.
en.mid: By 2050, one in ten species faces a high risk of extinction at 2 °C, and by 2100 narrow-range species face 2–3 times the extinction risk under high emissions; ecosystem services that shield coasts and pollinate crops weaken in step (IPCC, 2022; IPBES, 2019).
en.adapt: Marine protected networks, corridors linking forest patches, replanting diverse native species, and community ranger patrols keep ecosystems connected enough to adapt.
en.watch: Watch coral bleaching alerts, the arrival dates of migratory birds, and mangrove cover in your district; global reef and range trends are high-confidence, but local species losses vary with habitat fragmentation.
en.k50: 1 in 10 species at high extinction risk

id.lead: Bagi ekosistem dan keanekaragaman hayati, jangka dekat diukur dalam pemutihan dan pergeseran wilayah: pada 2040 terumbu karang mengalami pemutihan tahunan di 90% terumbu tropis, 15–25% wilayah burung bergeser ke atas, dan mangrove hilang 10–20% di tempat laut naik tercepat.
id.mid: Pada 2050, satu dari sepuluh spesies berisiko tinggi punah pada pemanasan 2 °C, dan pada 2100 spesies berwilayah sempit menghadapi risiko 2–3 kali lipat pada emisi tinggi; jasa ekosistem yang melindungi pesisir dan menyerbuki tanaman melemah seiring itu (IPCC, 2022; IPBES, 2019).
id.adapt: Jaringan kawasan lindung laut, koridor penghubung petak hutan, penanaman kembali spesies asli yang beragam, dan patroli ranger komunitas menjaga ekosistem tetap terhubung agar mampu beradaptasi.
id.watch: Pantau peringatan pemutihan karang, tanggal kedatangan burung migran, dan tutupan mangrove di kabupaten Anda; tren terumbu dan pergeseran wilayah berkeyakinan tinggi, tetapi kehilangan spesies lokal bergantung pada fragmentasi habitat.

en.lead: For health impacts, the near term shows up in clinics: by 2040 heat deaths rise 30–50% in cities above 35 °C, dengue expands 150–200 km poleward, and diarrheal cases jump 10–20% after floods.
en.mid: By 2050, heat and vector-borne disease stretch health systems thin, with 500,000+ heat deaths a year already recorded; by 2100 highland malaria doubles under high emissions without control, and mental-health burden grows alongside physical illness (Watts et al., 2021; WHO, 2023).
en.adapt: Heat-health alerts, screened housing, oral rehydration stocks, and clinics with flood-proof power and records protect the most exposed first.
en.watch: Watch heat-related admissions, dengue case counts, and clinic closures after storms; the direction of health risk is high-confidence, but local caseloads depend on sanitation, housing and health-system capacity.

id.lead: Bagi dampak kesehatan, jangka dekat tampak di klinik: pada 2040 kematian akibat panas naik 30–50% di kota di atas 35 °C, demam berdarah meluas 150–200 km ke arah kutub, dan kasus diare melonjak 10–20% setelah banjir.
id.mid: Pada 2050, panas dan penyakit tular vektor menipiskan kapasitas sistem kesehatan, dengan 500.000+ kematian akibat panas per tahun sudah tercatat; pada 2100 malaria dataran tinggi berlipat pada emisi tinggi tanpa pengendalian, dan beban kesehatan jiwa tumbuh bersama penyakit fisik (Watts dkk., 2021; WHO, 2023).
id.adapt: Peringatan kesehatan panas, rumah berkasa, stok oralit, dan klinik dengan listrik serta rekam medis tahan banjir melindungi yang paling rentan lebih dulu.
id.watch: Pantau rawat inap terkait panas, jumlah kasus demam berdarah, dan penutupan klinik setelah badai; arah risiko kesehatan berkeyakinan tinggi, tetapi kasus lokal bergantung pada sanitasi, perumahan dan kapasitas sistem kesehatan.
id.k100: malaria dataran tinggi ×2; beban jiwa naik

chapters.theme_en: economic impacts and financial preparedness under climate change
chapters.theme_id: dampak ekonomi dan kesiapsiagaan keuangan di tengah perubahan iklim

en.lead: For economic impacts and financial resilience, the near term is visible in budgets: by 2040 climate disasters cost 2–4% of GDP a year in exposed provinces, coastal insurance premiums rise 30–60%, and heat cuts work hours 10–15%.
en.mid: By 2050, loss and damage claims and adaptation costs together reach hundreds of billions a year, and by 2100 a high-emissions path shaves 15–25% off incomes in vulnerable deltas compared with a low-emissions path (IPCC, 2022; World Bank, 2022).
en.adapt: Emergency funds equal to three months of expenses, micro-insurance pools, diversified incomes, and building codes for wind, flood and heat reduce the shock.
en.watch: Watch local insurance renewals, disaster-related budget reallocations, and days of work lost to heat; global cost estimates are medium-confidence, but household exposure can be tracked directly.

id.lead: Bagi dampak ekonomi dan ketahanan keuangan, jangka dekat terlihat di anggaran: pada 2040 bencana iklim menghabiskan 2–4% PDB per tahun di provinsi terpapar, premi asuransi pesisir naik 30–60%, dan panas memangkas jam kerja 10–15%.
id.mid: Pada 2050, klaim kerugian dan kerusakan ditambah biaya adaptasi bersama-sama mencapai ratusan miliar per tahun, dan pada 2100 jalur emisi tinggi memangkas 15–25% pendapatan di delta rentan dibanding jalur emisi rendah (IPCC, 2022; World Bank, 2022).
id.adapt: Dana darurat setara tiga bulan pengeluaran, kumpulan mikro-asuransi, pendapatan yang terdiversifikasi, dan kode bangunan tahan angin, banjir dan panas meredam guncangan.
id.watch: Pantau perpanjangan asuransi setempat, realokasi anggaran akibat bencana, dan hari kerja yang hilang karena panas; estimasi biaya global berkeyakinan sedang, tetapi paparan rumah tangga dapat dilacak langsung.

en.lead: For migration and displacement, the near term is counted in people on the move: by 2040, 15–25 million a year are displaced by floods, storms and drought, and cities such as Dhaka, Lagos and Manila absorb 300,000–500,000 climate newcomers annually.
en.mid: By 2050, slow-onset loss of farmland and coastal land adds to sudden displacement, and by 2100 a high-emissions path displaces 100–150 million cumulatively from sub-3 m coasts and drying farmland (UNHCR, 2023; IPCC, 2022).
en.adapt: Legal aid, portable IDs and health records, rental support, and receiving-city plans for water, jobs and schools turn displacement from crisis into managed transition.
en.watch: Watch arrival numbers in your city, shelter occupancy, and school enrollment of newcomer children; displacement totals are medium-confidence, but local inflows are recorded and can guide planning.

id.lead: Bagi migrasi dan pengungsian, jangka dekat dihitung dari orang yang berpindah: pada 2040, 15–25 juta orang per tahun mengungsi akibat banjir, badai dan kekeringan, dan kota seperti Dhaka, Lagos dan Manila menampung 300.000–500.000 pendatang iklim setiap tahun.
id.mid: Pada 2050, hilangnya lahan pertanian dan pesisir secara perlahan menambah pengungsian mendadak, dan pada 2100 jalur emisi tinggi mengungsikan 100–150 juta orang secara kumulatif dari pesisir di bawah 3 m dan lahan kering (UNHCR, 2023; IPCC, 2022).
id.adapt: Bantuan hukum, identitas dan catatan kesehatan yang portabel, dukungan sewa, serta rencana kota penerima untuk air, pekerjaan dan sekolah mengubah pengungsian dari krisis menjadi transisi terkelola.
id.watch: Pantau jumlah kedatangan di kota Anda, tingkat hunian shelter, dan pendaftaran sekolah anak pendatang; total pengungsian berkeyakinan sedang, tetapi arus lokal tercatat dan dapat memandu perencanaan.

en.lead: For conflict and security, the near term appears where rains fail repeatedly: by 2040 competition over water and grazing drives 20–30% more local disputes in the Sahel and Horn when drought lasts 2–3 years, and storm-driven outages add to civil unrest.
en.mid: By 2050, food-price spikes and displacement pressure fragile states, and by 2100 a high-emissions path widens security gaps where institutions are already weak (IPCC, 2022; Mach et al., 2019).
en.adapt: Community water-peace committees, early-warning SMS, shared stockpiles, and transparent governance that shares resources before scarcity peaks reduce the trigger.
en.watch: Watch local water-point conflicts, food-price protests, and displacement inflows across borders; climate's link to conflict is context-dependent and medium-confidence, strongest where governance is weak.

id.lead: Bagi konflik dan keamanan, jangka dekat muncul ketika hujan gagal berulang: pada 2040 persaingan air dan padang rumput memicu 20–30% lebih banyak sengketa lokal di Sahel dan Tanduk Afrika saat kekeringan berlangsung 2–3 tahun, dan pemadaman akibat badai menambah keresahan sipil.
id.mid: Pada 2050, lonjakan harga pangan dan tekanan pengungsian membebani negara rapuh, dan pada 2100 jalur emisi tinggi memperlebar celah keamanan di tempat institusi sudah lemah (IPCC, 2022; Mach dkk., 2019).
id.adapt: Komite perdamaian air komunitas, SMS peringatan dini, stok bersama, dan tata kelola transparan yang membagi sumber daya sebelum kelangkaan memuncak mengurangi pemicu konflik.
id.watch: Pantau sengketa titik air setempat, protes harga pangan, dan arus pengungsian lintas batas; kaitan iklim-konflik bergantung konteks dan berkeyakinan sedang, terkuat di tempat tata kelola lemah.
